thread:
sasha: quick post-all-hands recap re: API / Console / Optimize timelines. wanted to capture the decisions and owners so customers get a single source of truth.

tom: can you confirm shipment windows for Adaptive Routing Panel and Optimize Insights? customers asked for dates for pilots.

sasha: Adaptive Routing Panel beta -> mid-Q3, GA -> late-Q3. Optimize Insights (suggestion engine + batch tuner) canary -> mid-Q3 (10% traffic), GA -> late-Q3 for hosted. Dedicated rollouts are opt-in and will run Q3->Q4; Private will get SDK/config release in Q4.

renee: what's in the beta vs canary for Console? we need to tell support teams.

sasha: beta: UI surface + compatibility badges (green/yellow/red), template import, and a preview mode for suggestions. canary: live apply flow + backend hooks with metrics.

alec: owners for comms/ops?

sasha: owners: renee (Console UX), tom (Optimize eng), alec (customer comms/support).

ops-bot: playbook reminder: all canaries must enable perf probes, prompt-set evals, and rollback hooks. see https://internal.redwood/canaries/optimize

tom: compatibility note: supported initially for decoder-only transformers (FP16/INT8). 4-bit profiles will be labeled experimental and opt-in only. UI will show "supported / limited / unsupported" per model. suggestions will never auto-change a route without explicit accept.

renee: rollback criteria? need specifics to include in the support runbook.

tom: rollback triggers: p95 latency increase >25% sustained for 10m OR measurable quality regression on the eval set for 2 consecutive runs. cost spikes alone are not auto-rollback unless >45%.

alec: can we get a short API example for the docs? customers want to see programmatic flow for applying a suggestion.

sasha: example snippet for docs: `POST /v1/optimize/suggestions/{suggestion_id}/action` body: `{ "action": "preview" }` and to accept: `{ "action": "apply", "mode": "dry-run" }`. include server response with suggestion_id and compatibility_summary.

renee: action items:
- renee: console mockups + badge copy by Mon EOD
- tom: publish canary gating doc + metric thresholds by Wed
- alec: draft customer-facing timeline blurb + API snippet for Friday

sasha: i'll update the roadmap sheet once deliverables are posted. ping here when items are live. closing unless blockers. :thumbsup:
